prompt: Add an endpoint to book a stay. `POST /bookings` takes `guestName` (required, 1 to 80 characters), `arrival` (required, a date), `nights` (required, 1 to 30) and an optional `note` (at most 200 characters). It returns 200 with `reference` (`BK-`, the arrival as yyyyMMdd, `-`, and nights as two digits, such as `BK-20990601-02`), `guestName`, `arrival`, `departure` (arrival plus nights) and `note`. An arrival before today is a 400 problem.

Add an endpoint to read a note. `GET /notes/{id}` returns 200 with `id`, `title` and `tags`, lower-cased and sorted. The notes are fixed and in memory: 1 is "Buy milk", tagged home and Errands; 2 is "Renew passport", tagged admin; 3 is "Call the bank", with no tags. An unknown id is a 404 problem.

Add an endpoint that turns a title into a URL slug. `POST /slugs` takes `title` (required, 1 to 80 characters) and returns 200 with `slug`: lower-case ASCII letters and digits, each run of other characters replaced by one hyphen, and no hyphen at either end, so `  .NET 10 -- what's new?  ` gives `net-10-what-s-new`. A title with no letters or digits is a 400 problem.

Add an endpoint that summarises scores. `POST /scores` takes `values` (required, a list of 1 to 50 integers) and returns 200 with `count`, `mean` (rounded to one decimal place) and `max`. An empty list, or one longer than 50, is a 400.
